title.narrative: Capacity building water management WUO for sustainable agriculture, Ukraine

description.narrative: The purpose of this project is to support the setting up of a water users' organisation (WUO) and the capacity building of its private and public members on water management for sustainable agriculture in Ukraine.Small farmers and medium-scale agricultural producers will learn to manage the trade-offs of water drainage systems on agricultural production areas and natural protected areas in the region. Under and integrated water-agro nexus approach, the water users will be able to prevent flood and droughts by the efficient management of water drainage systems; which will lead to the sustainable use of water for agricultural production.The project has a positive impact on:SDG 8: inclusive and sustainable economic growth: support productive activities, decent job creation, entrepreneurship, creativity and innovation.SDG 15: Protect, restore and promote sustainable use of terrestrial ecosystems, sustainably manage forests, combat desertification, and halt and reverse land degradation and halt biodiversity loss, fostering poverty reduction strategies.SDG 17: Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the partnership for sustainable development.

title.narrative: Number of parties formally starting a business collaboration and/or partnership - Total

comment.narrative:
Five different types of partnerships and cooperation were started :
1) The strong partnership between Kolodyazhnenska Territorial community, regional Water management department and NGO Primavera was established for the setting up of the WUO.
2) The key group of local initiators (big Farm “Pyatydni”, Regional Water management department and Territorial community) to establish a first WUO was organized and stablished.
3) Cooperation with the State agency of Melioration, and the USAID project AGRO was organized for further advice and support of the WUOs in Volyn region
4) Cooperation with state agency of water resources of Ukraine and NGO Primavera was developed for coordination of water management issues on the local and river basin level and for further development of legislation
6) The partnership between NGO and local and regional stakeholders and business companies was established for formulation of B2B proposal with involvement of Dutch companies. The join project for drainage system modernization was formulated and submitted to the UPF program

title.narrative: Number of courses/trainings developed/adopted for local dissemination - Total

comment.narrative:
Capacity building to members of the WUO.
Three interactive workshops and four training were organized and implemented on the pilot area for local and regional stakeholders with involvement of Ukrainian and Dutch experts of NGO Primavera.
The four trainings were implemented on the following topics: 1) Legal framework for the setting up of WUOs in drainage areas and international experiences of the WUOs on the drainage systems. 2) Technical aspects of drainage systems operation and maintenance and innovations on modernization of multifunctional drainage systems areas such as in Kolodyazhenska Territorial community; 3) Water management and agricultural production. Impacts on biodiversity, natural environments and sustainable water use. 4) International examples (best practices and lessons learned) on the local integrated water management including water-agro-natural environment issues based on the Dutch case. Each of the trainingshad several separate lectures provided by local and Dutch experts.
